rules.reading: plan section 4 on one row's panel record of one condition (<out>/<body>/eval/<row>/<behavior>/<condition>.json, panels.record_path): 'shown' if the record is judged (20 episodes on seeds 3042-3061, none failed to run, panels.counts) with 20/20 up and at least 17/20 meeting every limit (Stage 1 section 4); 'survives only' with 20/20 up and fewer meeting every limit; 'fails' with fewer up; 'not judged' for a record that is not (incomplete, an episode that failed to run, not run for want of a stance); 'not run' without a record; the failing limits are named with counts: the success terms the episodes that stayed up failed (their failed_terms), and for the falls their causes, their candidates (control.CANDIDATE_RULE) and decision 20's label (the record's failure.falls_label, 'not attributed' until eval --attribute has run, speedfit.ATTRIBUTION_RULE); a shown record's few failures are listed too
rules.questions: Q1 (arm S, a body that is its own pick) and Q2 (arm K, a faster-knee body: speedfit.pick_of names another) per body: walk/brisk and walk/fr05 of R2s/<seed> (0 ms), each beside its baseline: on arm S Stage 1's R2 row of the start's CMA-ES seed on the same body (<stage1>/<body>/eval/R2/<seed>/; Stage 1's panels, same seeds and judge), on arm K R2@0ms on the body (the pick's gains without a refit), with the pick's Stage 1 R2 row shown as well (another body); Q3: the same conditions of R2s/<seed>@10ms beside R2@10ms (the start at 10 ms), the other five conditions at 10 ms reported; speed G5's pooled counts (0-10 ms) are not an answer (speedfit.SELECTION_RULE)
rules.trade: plan section 4: a speed fit that loses the nominal walk or a target turn at 0 ms is a trade, not a success: per condition of walk/nominal, turn/walking_0.35_left, turn/walking_0.35_right, turn/in_place_0.50_left, turn/in_place_0.50_right, a trade when the 0 ms baseline (QUESTIONS_RULE) shows it and R2s/<seed> does not; 'not lost' when neither shows it (the baseline did not either), 'kept' when both do, 'gained' when only R2s does, and 'unknown' while either record is not judged
rules.baseline: Stage 1's R2 records were made by Stage 1's code: their keys name its panel sources, and the round's code differs (this round's edits and the faster-knee registry, STAGE1B_PLAN.md section 6), so Stage 1's tables are read from its own commit; their episodes reproduce on the round's code (the review's check on brisk and Fr 0.05 episodes, and speedfit's test on a recorded G5 episode)
